headline: SEA @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.48 at HOU 4.06, with a projected total of 8.54. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: SEA moved -0.76 runs while HOU moved -0.26, changing the projected margin by -0.50 runs. The projected total fell -1.01, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Tatsuya Imai has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.3 ER over the last 3 starts. Batter research is strongest for Julio Rodríguez, Josh Naylor, Jose Altuve, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Cal Raleigh, Leo Rivas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
